purpose: Lightweight routing metadata for preview and first-pass template selection. This complements the family catalogs; it does not replace manual catalog review for publication or low-confidence choices.
entity_language: Contracts use generic focal_entity, target_entity, feature, item, category, association, and significance roles. They must not restrict routing to genes; gene symbols are only one possible omics entity label.

modes.preview: Use these contracts to recommend a likely template quickly, then inspect only the selected catalog entry and script before rendering.
modes.publication: Use these contracts as a shortlist, then confirm against plots.yaml, the family catalog, previews, palette guidance, and final-size visual QA.
modes.template_dev: Use these contracts to identify metadata gaps before editing the reusable template library.

templates.title: One-to-many correlation scatter
templates.use_when: Show signed associations from one focal entity to many related entities with a central reference and readable item labels.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for all-by-all matrices, pairwise sample scatter, or network inference. The links are display connectors, not physical or causal edges.

templates.title: Correlation bubble grid with stars
templates.use_when: Draw a rectangular category-by-category grid where colour is a supplied signed coefficient and size or stars encode supplied significance.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use when the coefficient must be computed from raw sample rows, when cell shape rather than size encodes significance, or when a focal hub story is the main message.

templates.title: Differential-expression volcano plot
templates.use_when: Provide an overview of effect size and adjusted significance across many tested features.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use as the sole evidence for biological importance or when adjusted significance is unavailable.

templates.title: Correlation scatter with fit
templates.use_when: Show the association of two numeric variables across observation rows with a fitted line.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for coefficient-only result tables or one focal entity correlated with many targets.

templates.title: Enrichment dotplot
templates.use_when: Rank enrichment terms using ratio, count, and adjusted significance already supplied by upstream analysis.
templates.avoid_when: Do not run enrichment in the plotting step or use when term-by-group signed heatmap structure is required.

templates.title: Basic boxplot
templates.use_when: Summarize a numeric distribution across categories.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use when pairing, rainclouds, violins, or raw-point emphasis is essential.

templates.title: Basic heatmap
templates.use_when: Show a supplied numeric matrix or wide feature-by-sample table as a heatmap.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for long association tables where points, bubbles, or signs encode significance.

templates.title: Survival curve
templates.use_when: Plot a supplied time-to-event table split by a group.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use when only survival summary statistics are available without individual time/status rows.

templates.title: Focus network
templates.use_when: Show a supplied set of relationships around a focal node or module.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for correlation result tables unless the user explicitly wants a network interpretation.

templates.title: Stress-layout network
templates.use_when: Compute and draw a stress layout from a supplied edge table when node positions are not already supplied.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for pre-positioned cartesian coordinates or for a non-network association result unless a network reading is intended.

templates.title: Basic bar chart
templates.use_when: Compare a single numeric value across discrete categories.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for grouped, stacked, percent, enrichment, or patient swimmer structures.

templates.title: Basic line chart
templates.use_when: Connect ordered observations of one or more series as lines.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for survival curves, stacked areas, bump ranks, or independent-panel series.

templates.title: Basic pie chart
templates.use_when: Show part-to-whole composition as a full pie for mutually exclusive parts.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use when precise comparison, many slices, nested composition, or a doughnut ring is required.

templates.title: Doughnut chart
templates.use_when: Show part-to-whole composition as a ring with a hollow center.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use when a solid pie, nested two-ring composition, or radial bar geometry is intended.

templates.title: Two-level Sankey diagram
templates.use_when: Show weighted flows from one source column to one target column.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for containment hierarchies, all-by-all association grids, or unweighted networks where flow conservation is not the claim.

templates.title: Vertical tree / dendrogram
templates.use_when: Draw a supplied rooted hierarchy from parent/path edges.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for clustering from numeric matrices, conserved flows, or sunburst angle-based hierarchy.

templates.title: Basic radar chart
templates.use_when: Overlay a small number of series on the same set of named numeric axes.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for many series or when exact magnitude comparison matters more than profile shape.

templates.title: Multi-set flower / petal diagram
templates.use_when: Show five or more supplied sets as petals around a shared core count, with supplied total and unique counts per set.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for 2-4 classic Venn circles, UpSet combination matrices, element membership enumeration, or enrichment testing in the plotting step.
risks: Do not use for 2-4 classic Venn circles (bar-venn) or UpSet matrices (bar-upset).

templates.title: Grouped lower-triangle correlation heatmap
templates.use_when: Show a supplied pairwise correlation table ordered into named variable groups, with block gaps, stars from supplied p cuts, and group braces.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for ungrouped square significance matrices, two-set X-vs-Y sample-row correlations, rotated triangles, or computing Spearman inside the plot script.
risks: Requires a var-to-group map plus supplied rho/p; do not compute Spearman here.

templates.title: Rotated triangular correlation heatmap
templates.use_when: Show a supplied lower-triangle correlation as an upright 45-degree rotated triangle with optional group gaps, left-hypotenuse annotation tracks, and non-significant plus cells.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for flat star-cell lower triangles, square upper/lower glyph split matrices, grouped-brace matrices, or computing Spearman inside the plot script.
risks: Prefer heatmap-shape for flat star triangles; supply rho rather than computing it.

templates.title: Grouped bar chart
templates.use_when: Compare several groups side by side within each category using supplied values.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use when values should stack to a total, normalize to 100%, or represent enrichment-specific encodings.

templates.title: Stacked bar chart
templates.use_when: Show supplied component magnitudes stacked within each category.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for side-by-side comparisons or 100% normalized composition unless the request names stacking.

templates.title: Percent stacked bar chart
templates.use_when: Compare supplied part-to-whole composition across categories on a 100% scale.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use when absolute counts are the main evidence or when raw values should not be normalized visually.

templates.title: Bar chart with error bars
templates.use_when: Show a supplied summary value with an explicit uncertainty column.
templates.avoid_when: Do not invent uncertainty; use only when error, SE, SD, CI, ymin, or ymax is supplied.

templates.title: Waterfall chart
templates.use_when: Show ordered supplied increments or signed changes accumulating from a start to an end.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for independent category comparisons or gene-by-sample alteration grids.

templates.title: Waffle chart
templates.use_when: Show supplied part-to-whole composition as unit-square tiles.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use when a bar, pie, stacked bar, or exact value comparison is clearer.

templates.title: UpSet combination matrix
templates.use_when: Show supplied set-combination counts as an UpSet matrix.
templates.avoid_when: Do not enumerate combinations from raw samples in the plotting step; use Venn for 2-4 overlapping circles.

templates.title: Overlapping Venn circles
templates.use_when: Show overlap of 2-4 supplied sets from an item-by-set membership table.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for five or more sets, UpSet combination matrices, or enrichment testing.

templates.title: Grouped boxplot
templates.use_when: Compare numeric distributions across categories and a second grouping factor.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for a single grouping factor or paired-unit connectors.

templates.title: Violin plot
templates.use_when: Show the full supplied distribution shape per category.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use when quartiles only, raw points, rainclouds, or ridgelines are the requested evidence.

templates.title: Boxplot with points
templates.use_when: Combine a box summary with the underlying supplied observations.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use when a beeswarm, jitter, or raincloud is the requested raw-point geometry.

templates.title: Paired boxplot
templates.use_when: Compare paired observations across conditions using a supplied pair identifier.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for unpaired groups or when the pair identifier is absent.

templates.title: Raincloud plot
templates.use_when: Show a half-violin, box, and raw points for supplied category distributions.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use when a simple boxplot, violin, or ridgeline is the requested geometry.

templates.title: Grouped line chart
templates.use_when: Overlay several supplied series on a shared ordered axis.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use when values should stack or occupy independent panels.

templates.title: Stacked area chart
templates.use_when: Stack grouped supplied values along an ordered axis as areas.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use if stacking would imply a misleading total or if independent y-scales are needed.

templates.title: Dual-axis hydrograph
templates.use_when: Draw two supplied time series on one panel with opposite visual directions.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use when a shared-scale overlay or two independent panels is more honest.

templates.title: Two-panel independent time series
templates.use_when: Show two supplied time series as stacked panels sharing time but not y-scale.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use when a single-panel dual-axis or shared-scale overlay is requested.

templates.title: Ridgeline / joyplot
templates.use_when: Stack supplied one-dimensional distributions as ridgelines by group, optionally faceted by feature.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for mirrored violins, rainclouds, two-dimensional density, or genome-coordinate coverage.

templates.title: Basic scatter plot
templates.use_when: Plot two supplied numeric variables against each other without grouping or extra encodings.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use when grouping, point size, density, fit lines, or SVG glyphs are needed.

templates.title: Grouped scatter plot
templates.use_when: Color supplied x-y points by a categorical group.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for ungrouped scatter, SVG glyph marks, Voronoi tiles, ternary position, or UMAP-circos composition.

templates.title: Bubble scatter plot
templates.use_when: Encode a third supplied numeric variable as point size on an x-y scatter.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use when size is not comparable across points or overplotting calls for hex/contour density.

templates.title: Category-by-category bubble grid
templates.use_when: Draw bubbles on two categorical axes where size or colour encodes a supplied numeric value.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for numeric pairs plots, a single x-y scatter, or coefficient-only correlation matrices.

templates.title: Pairs plot with correlation tiles
templates.use_when: Compare several supplied numeric variables with pairwise scatter and correlation tiles.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for one pair, a category bubble grid, or coefficient-only square matrices; large variable sets belong on a heatmap.

templates.title: Jitter plot by category
templates.use_when: Show supplied raw values within categories by jittering overlapping points.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use when beeswarm, boxplot, violin, or grouped jitter better represents the distribution.

templates.title: Beeswarm plot
templates.use_when: Show every supplied observation in a category as a compact non-random swarm.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use when jitter, boxplot, violin, or a grouped swarm is requested.

templates.title: Cleveland dot plot
templates.use_when: Rank categories by one supplied numeric value with a stem from zero to each point.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for before/after dumbbells, signed delta lollipops, mutation lollipops, or full distributions.

templates.title: Ranked lollipop / score plot
templates.use_when: Rank many supplied items by a score and mark each with a lollipop stem.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for polar/radial lollipops, signed p-sized delta lollipops, or protein mutation lollipops.

templates.title: Signed lollipop with p-value size
templates.use_when: Show supplied signed deltas as lollipops through zero, with p-value or supplied significance encoded by size/stroke.
templates.avoid_when: Do not run tests or signature scoring in the plot script; do not use for protein mutation lollipops or before/after dumbbells.

templates.title: Association-dot heatmap
templates.use_when: Draw a two-category grid where colour is a supplied signed coefficient and shape marks a supplied p-value cutoff.
templates.avoid_when: Do not compute rho from samples, use size-plus-stars, split cells into triangles, or represent a focal hub story.

templates.title: Diagonal-split correlation heatmap
templates.use_when: Split each supplied association-grid cell into two triangles for coefficient and p-value or another supplied continuous measure.
templates.avoid_when: Do not compute correlations, impute missing pairs, or use when a single glyph with shape/size is intended.

templates.title: Correlation heatmap with significance marks
templates.use_when: Show a square correlation matrix with supplied sample-row numeric variables and significance marks.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for precomputed long rho/p association grids or two-set X-vs-Y correlations.

templates.title: Clustered heatmap
templates.use_when: Cluster a supplied feature-by-sample numeric matrix with optional row or column annotations.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for unclustered matrices, precomputed correlation grids, or cutree block score heatmaps.

templates.title: Clustered heatmap with cutree blocks
templates.use_when: Cluster a supplied rectangular score matrix and show row/column cutree blocks.
templates.avoid_when: Do not compute correlations or z-score in the plot script; use basic clustered heatmap for expression matrices.

templates.title: Term-by-group enrichment heatmap
templates.use_when: Compare supplied enrichment terms across groups using supplied adjusted p/q values and direction.
templates.avoid_when: Do not run enrichment, convert species, cluster terms, or use for a ranked one-contrast enrichment list.

templates.title: Multi-level Sankey diagram
templates.use_when: Show conserved flows across several inferred node levels from a supplied edge list.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for a simple two-column flow, parallel sets, containment hierarchy, or sunburst.

templates.title: Parallel-sets diagram
templates.use_when: Show supplied counts flowing across several categorical axes.
templates.avoid_when: Do not tabulate raw samples in the script or use for a source-target edge list.

templates.title: Clustering dendrogram
templates.use_when: Cluster supplied leaves from a numeric feature matrix and draw the dendrogram.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for named parent/path hierarchies, heatmaps with dendrograms, treemaps, sunbursts, or phylogenetic claims without phylogenetic input.

templates.title: Hierarchical treemap
templates.use_when: Show a supplied hierarchy as nested rectangles whose area encodes a supplied leaf size.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for node-link trees, circle packing, sunbursts, or statistical relationship claims from adjacency.

templates.title: Circle packing
templates.use_when: Show a supplied hierarchy as nested circles whose area encodes a supplied leaf size.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for treemaps, sunbursts, icicle partitions, node-link trees, or adjacency-based statistical claims.

templates.title: Icicle / rectangular partition
templates.use_when: Show a supplied hierarchy as stacked rectangular bands where width encodes supplied leaf size.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for circular sunbursts, treemaps, circle packs, node-link trees, or classification trees with outer tracks.

templates.title: Basic sunburst chart
templates.use_when: Show a supplied hierarchy as concentric rings where angle encodes descendant size.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for node-link trees, Sankey flows, or outer-track classification trees.

templates.title: Faceted radar charts
templates.use_when: Draw one radar per supplied series so overlapping polygons do not obscure the comparison.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use when two or a few series should share one radar or when exact magnitude comparison is primary.

templates.title: Bar chart with axis break
templates.use_when: Compare category magnitudes when a supplied value range contains one or a few much larger values and the user explicitly wants an axis break.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use an axis break for ordinary category comparisons or to exaggerate small differences.

templates.title: Butterfly / diverging bar chart
templates.use_when: Mirror two supplied series around a shared category axis for left-versus-right comparison.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for one-sided rankings, stacked composition, or a signed single-series bar chart.

templates.title: Opposite-direction bar chart
templates.use_when: Show supplied values extending in opposite directions from a baseline when a direction column such as gain/loss or up/down is present.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for enrichment ratio tables, one-to-many associations, or two matched series that should mirror as a butterfly chart.

templates.title: Radial bar chart
templates.use_when: Map one supplied magnitude per category to radial bar length around a circle.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for grouped radial bars, stacked polar bars, or circos doughnut-bar compositions.

templates.title: Grouped radial bar chart
templates.use_when: Compare several supplied groups as radial bars across the same category axis.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for a single radial series or for a composition ring with inner bars.

templates.title: Polar horizontal bars
templates.use_when: Draw category magnitudes as a horizontal-bar mapping in polar coordinates when that geometry is requested.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for ordinary bars, polar vertical bars, stacked rings, or sector bars without explicit polar-horizontal intent.

templates.title: Polar vertical bars
templates.use_when: Draw category magnitudes as a vertical-bar mapping in polar coordinates when requested.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for ordinary bars, polar horizontal bars, stacked rings, or sector bars without explicit polar-vertical intent.

templates.title: Polar stacked bars
templates.use_when: Stack supplied components within each category as filled polar bars.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use when the hollow ring variant or a rectangular stacked bar is intended.

templates.title: Polar stacked ring bars
templates.use_when: Stack supplied components as a hollow polar ring by category.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use when a filled polar stack or ordinary percent stacked bar is clearer.

templates.title: Polar sector bars
templates.use_when: Encode supplied category values as polar sectors when a sector-bar geometry is requested.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for a pie or Nightingale rose where slice angle or radius has a different meaning.

templates.title: Enrichment bars with gene-ratio points
templates.use_when: Rank supplied enrichment terms as bars with gene-ratio points, often faceted by ontology.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for classic dotplots, gene-count-only bars, term-by-group heatmaps, or enrichment computed inside the plotting step.

templates.title: Enrichment bars by gene count
templates.use_when: Rank supplied enrichment terms by gene count or a supplied gene-list-derived count.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use when gene ratio is the requested x encoding or when a classification tree with an outer track is needed.

templates.title: Grouped enrichment bars
templates.use_when: Compare supplied enrichment statistics for the same or comparable terms across groups or ontologies.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for a single-contrast enrichment list or for enrichment bars aligned to a DE heatmap.

templates.title: Enrichment bars with expanded category headers
templates.use_when: Group supplied enrichment terms under category headers on the y-axis.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use when ontology facets, a tree enrichment ring, or a term-by-group heatmap better encodes the grouping.

templates.title: Horizontal bars with SVG category marks
templates.use_when: Compare supplied category magnitudes while replacing category text with provided SVG or icon marks.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for ordinary text-labelled bars, unit-square waffles, or x-y SVG scatters.

templates.title: Swimmer plot of patient treatment lanes
templates.use_when: Show supplied interval records as one lane per unit on a time axis, with optional treatment, response, or stop annotations.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for magnitude bars, two-point dumbbells, or population survival curves.

templates.title: Rounded boxplot
templates.use_when: Summarize supplied numeric distributions by category with rounded box geometry when requested.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use when a standard rectangular boxplot or distribution-rich geometry is intended.

templates.title: Boxplot with Bezier pair links
templates.use_when: Overlay paired observations on boxes and connect each supplied pair_id with Bezier curves within each facet; do not infer pairs from row order.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use when straight pair connectors or an x-y Bezier scatter is intended.

templates.title: Differential-expression boxplot
templates.use_when: Compare supplied expression or abundance values for selected features across sample groups.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use a volcano as a substitute or facet many features when a single feature panel is requested.

templates.title: Two-panel differential boxplot
templates.use_when: Show two supplied features or contrasts as paired differential box panels.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for one feature or for many-feature facet grids.

templates.title: Faceted differential boxplot
templates.use_when: Facet supplied expression distributions across many selected features.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for one or two features when simpler differential boxplots are clearer.

templates.title: Banded two-level differential boxplot
templates.use_when: Compare two groups within many x-axis categories with alternating background bands and per-category significance labels.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use a plain two-factor boxplot without bands, a single-category DE panel, or faceted many-feature panels.

templates.title: Vertical raincloud plot
templates.use_when: Combine half-violin, box, and raw observations in a vertical raincloud layout.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use when the horizontal raincloud or a simpler box-plus-points plot is intended.

templates.title: Differential raincloud plot
templates.use_when: Use a raincloud layout for supplied differential-expression or contrast groups.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for a generic raincloud when contrast annotations are not needed.

templates.title: Polar boxplot
templates.use_when: Place supplied category-wise box summaries around a circle.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use when a rectangular boxplot or radial heatmap-plus-violin fan is intended.

templates.title: Polar heatmap with outer violins
templates.use_when: Draw a radial fan with an inner heatmap of group means and outer violins from supplied raw values.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for plain polar boxplots or rectangular heatmaps.

templates.title: Bump chart
templates.use_when: Track supplied item ranks or ordered scores across sequential stages.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for raw magnitude trends where rank order is not the message.

templates.title: Line with peak highlight
templates.use_when: Show an ordered supplied series and emphasize the window around its peak.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use when no peak or interval should be emphasized.

templates.title: Rounded doughnut chart
templates.use_when: Show supplied part-to-whole composition as a doughnut with rounded slice corners and gaps.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use when ordinary doughnut slices, nested rings, or a Nightingale rose are intended.

templates.title: Doughnut with outer radial bars
templates.use_when: Show supplied group-by-part composition as a circos doughnut with corresponding inner radial bars.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for plain doughnuts, nested pies, Nightingale roses, or grouped radial bars without the composition ring.

templates.title: Half-pie chart
templates.use_when: Show supplied mutually exclusive parts as a 180-degree composition.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use when a full pie, doughnut, or precise bar comparison is clearer.

templates.title: Nested two-ring pie
templates.use_when: Draw supplied inner and outer ring slices when the rings are separately tagged series.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use when inner totals should be summed from outer items; use pie-combine for that structure.

templates.title: Combined nested pie
templates.use_when: Show supplied items in an outer ring and their parent category totals in an inner ring.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use when the two rings are independent supplied series.

templates.title: Nightingale rose chart
templates.use_when: Encode supplied category values as equal-angle polar rose sectors, with radius carrying magnitude.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for ordinary pies, rounded doughnuts, or polar sector bars without rose-chart intent.

templates.title: Ternary composition scatter
templates.use_when: Place each supplied observation in a three-component simplex using non-negative component scores.
templates.avoid_when: Do not compute component scores or use for ordinary Cartesian scatter or a single composition pie.

templates.title: UMAP in a circos composition ring
templates.use_when: Show a supplied two-dimensional embedding inside a circos composition ring with supplied categorical tracks.
templates.avoid_when: Do not run UMAP or clustering in the plotting step, and do not use when a plain grouped scatter is enough.

templates.title: Voronoi scatter
templates.use_when: Fill the plane around supplied x-y points as nearest-site tiles coloured by group.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for plain point scatter, convex hull contours, hex bins, or inferred embeddings.

templates.title: Hexbin density scatter
templates.use_when: Summarize a dense supplied x-y point cloud as hexagonal bins to reduce overplotting.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for small n where individual points should remain visible or when contours are requested.

templates.title: Scatter with density contours
templates.use_when: Overlay density contours on supplied x-y observations to show concentration.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use when simple points, hex bins, or Voronoi regions better answer the question.

templates.title: Scatter with marginal boxplots
templates.use_when: Combine supplied x-y observations with marginal group distributions and an association summary.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use when only the scatter or only the category distributions are needed.

templates.title: Grouped jitter plot
templates.use_when: Show supplied raw values within categories and colour or split them by a second grouping factor.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for a single grouping factor or when beeswarm positioning is required.

templates.title: Grouped beeswarm plot
templates.use_when: Show each supplied observation within categories using swarm positioning and a second group split.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for a single grouping factor or when random jitter is requested.

templates.title: Polar lollipop plot
templates.use_when: Place supplied ranked scores around a circle as polar lollipop stems.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for linear ranked lists, radial spoke lollipops, grouped circular lollipops, or mutation lollipops.

templates.title: Radial lollipop plot
templates.use_when: Draw supplied scores as radial spokes from a common origin.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for polar lollipops on a ring, grouped circular lollipops, or linear ranked lists.

templates.title: Circular lollipop with error bars
templates.use_when: Draw supplied subgroup means and uncertainty as grouped circular lollipops with sector labels.
templates.avoid_when: Do not compute standard errors in the script or use plain polar/radial lollipop variants.

templates.title: Single-axis bubble strip
templates.use_when: Place sized supplied points along one categorical axis with one row per series.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for two-numeric scatter or a standard bubble chart.

templates.title: Dumbbell plot
templates.use_when: Compare two supplied numeric values per category as connected points.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use when more than two groups, a shaded region, or a rectangular connector is the requested emphasis.

templates.title: Multi-group dumbbell plot
templates.use_when: Connect more than two supplied group values per category as a grouped dumbbell.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for strict two-point dumbbells.

templates.title: Horizontal dumbbell plot
templates.use_when: Draw supplied two-group category comparisons as horizontal dumbbells.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use when a vertical or region-shaded dumbbell is requested.

templates.title: Rectangular dumbbell plot
templates.use_when: Connect two supplied group values with a thick rectangular bar rather than a thin line.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for ordinary thin-line dumbbells or mean-SD region overlays.

templates.title: Dumbbell with mean-SD region
templates.use_when: Show supplied two-group category comparisons with a shaded mean-plus-spread region behind the points.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use when only a two-dot connector is needed.

templates.title: Paired before-after scatter
templates.use_when: Link two supplied measurements of the same unit as paired points.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for unpaired group dots or paired boxplots.

templates.title: Diagonal comparison scatter
templates.use_when: Compare two supplied matched numeric measurements against the y = x reference line.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for correlation fits without an identity reference.

templates.title: Bezier-linked scatter
templates.use_when: Connect related supplied scatter points with curved Bezier paths.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for ordinary x-y point clouds, one-to-many hub layouts, ternary compositions, or paired boxplots with Bezier links.

templates.title: Scatter with SVG glyphs
templates.use_when: Draw supplied x-y observations with SVG or icon glyphs instead of ordinary point marks.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for ordinary grouped scatter, bubble-size encodings, or icon-labelled bars.

templates.title: MA plot
templates.use_when: Show supplied log fold-change against average abundance to inspect mean-dependent bias.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use when the requested view is significance versus fold-change as a volcano plot.

templates.title: Quadrant scatter plot
templates.use_when: Split supplied x-y scores into labelled quadrants using explicit threshold lines.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for plain unthresholded scatter or volcano-style significance cutoffs.

templates.title: Volcano plot with zoom inset
templates.use_when: Show supplied feature-level effect and p-value results as a volcano overview with one magnified labelled inset.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for overview-only volcanoes or MA plots, and do not run differential testing in the script.

templates.title: Grouped forest of trees
templates.use_when: Draw several supplied root trees in one figure from parent rows that define multiple roots.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for a single-root hierarchy, clustering dendrogram, sunburst, or Sankey flow.

templates.title: Classification tree with outer enrichment track
templates.use_when: Show a supplied class-to-term tree with count and significance on an outer circular track.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for ranked Cartesian enrichment bars, term-by-group heatmaps, sunbursts, or clustering dendrograms.

templates.title: Layered sunburst with outside labels
templates.use_when: Draw a supplied hierarchy as a layered sunburst with outside labels and optional per-node colours.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use when a basic sunburst, node-link tree, or enrichment ring carries the intended structure.

templates.title: Basic node-link graph
templates.use_when: Draw a supplied network as a basic node-link layout, especially when node positions or a simple readable layout are already part of the data package.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for hierarchical parent-child tables, Sankey-style conserved flows, or genomic Circos links. Use layout-specific graph templates when force, arc, hive, matrix, chord, or cartesian layout is requested.

templates.title: Force-directed graph
templates.use_when: Draw a network with a force-layout visual idiom from supplied node and edge tables; keep supplied node coordinates when they are provided.
templates.avoid_when: Do not choose this when the requested claim is signed edge readability, adjacency ordering, class-axis connectivity, or genomic linkage; use the corresponding graph or ideogram template instead.

templates.title: Circular network layout
templates.use_when: Place supplied network nodes around a circle and draw equal-spacing links or chords between nodes.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use when sector width must encode flow totals, when links are genomic intervals, when a dual-ring hub-vs-category layout is requested, or when a linear arc, hive, fabric, or matrix view is requested.

templates.title: Concentric dual-ring network
templates.use_when: Place hub nodes on an inner ring and category-grouped nodes on an outer ring; colour edges by the outer class when an outer endpoint exists, and encode supplied integer weight as line width.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for equal-spacing single-ring layouts, Circos chords whose sector width is total flow, hive axis membership claims, or genomic ideogram links. Do not infer ring membership or edge weights in the script. Ring must be supplied as inner|outer.

templates.title: Weighted Circos chord
templates.use_when: Show supplied from-to non-negative flows as circular ribbons whose sector widths summarize total flow touching each entity.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for signed correlation edges, genomic rearrangement ribbons, two-genome synteny, or Sankey flows where stage order is the main reading task.

templates.title: Linear arc diagram
templates.use_when: Place nodes along one axis and draw signed links as arcs when edge sign and link span are the visual message.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for circular chord flow, force-layout exploration, hierarchy, Sankey flow, or genomic links on chromosome ideograms.

templates.title: Hive plot
templates.use_when: Compare signed connectivity among supplied node classes by placing each class on a radial axis.
templates.avoid_when: Do not compute axis membership from the network. Do not use for generic force layouts, chord flows, or linear arc diagrams unless that axis-based reading is requested.

templates.title: BioFabric network
templates.use_when: Show a dense signed network as ordered node ranges and edge spans so individual links remain readable.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use when a spatial force layout, class-axis hive view, or matrix adjacency view is the requested visual grammar.

templates.title: Adjacency matrix
templates.use_when: Encode signed network edges in a point matrix when module order, hubs, and dense pairwise adjacency are more important than spatial layout.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for ordinary numeric heatmaps, unsigned flow chords, or network layouts where node position is the key reading task.

templates.title: Cartesian network layout
templates.use_when: Draw network links on explicit Cartesian node coordinates when x/y positions carry meaning and must be preserved.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use when coordinates should be inferred from edges, or when a circular, hive, fabric, matrix, or genomic ideogram layout is requested.

templates.title: Group-split circular heatmap
templates.use_when: Show entities split by a supplied group on a circular heatmap, with significance or q-value carried as a track and multiple numeric columns as heatmap layers.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for genomic Circos tracks, ordinary clustered heatmaps, or ranked enrichment lists. The entity groups and q-values must be supplied.

templates.title: DE heatmap with aligned enrichment zooms
intent_keywords: 表达热图和多通路富集
templates.use_when: Combine a supplied expression matrix with supplied row, column, and enrichment sidecars so enrichment bars align to row slices.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for standalone enrichment dotplots or bar charts, and do not infer enrichment terms inside the router or MCP layer.

templates.title: Mantel-style correlation heatmap
templates.use_when: Show relationships between two supplied variable sets from a sample-by-variable matrix using the Mantel-style heatmap grammar.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for precomputed long x-y-rho tables, single-set correlation triangles, or ordinary expression clustering.

templates.title: Mantel heatmap with sized links
templates.use_when: Use when the Mantel-style display should emphasize link size in addition to the heatmap background.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use when the user asked for a plain Mantel heatmap, supplied association-dot grid, or single-set correlation triangle.

templates.title: Saturation mutation energy heatmap
templates.use_when: Show a residue or site by mutant-amino-acid numeric matrix, typically for supplied saturation mutation scores or energy changes.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for gene-by-sample alteration events, protein lollipop counts, or ordinary expression heatmaps.

templates.title: Gene × sample oncoprint
templates.use_when: Show supplied gene-by-sample alteration events as glyphs, with multiple alteration types represented by multiple rows or delimited event values.
templates.avoid_when: Do not parse MAF, query cBioPortal, or compute alteration calls in MCP. Do not use for numeric expression heatmaps or mutation-energy matrices.

templates.title: Star-cell correlation triangle
templates.use_when: Use a sample-by-variable numeric matrix when the requested display is a correlation triangle with star or shape overlays.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for precomputed long association grids, two-set X-vs-Y heatmaps, or group-split circular heatmaps.

templates.title: Two-set correlation heatmap
templates.use_when: Show correlations between two supplied variable sets from one sample-by-variable matrix.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for a precomputed long association table, a single-set triangle, a Mantel-style link display, or an expression heatmap without a two-set comparison intent.

templates.title: Two-set heatmap with shape overlay
templates.use_when: Show a two-variable-set heatmap where a supplied group or display rule is represented with shape overlays.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for plain two-set heatmaps, supplied x-y-rho association grids, or single-set star-cell triangles.

templates.title: Transcript gene-structure tracks
templates.use_when: Draw supplied transcript, exon, CDS, or UTR intervals on transcript structure tracks.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for chromosome-level loci, G-banding, coverage tracks, protein lollipops, or genomic Circos plots.

templates.title: Chromosome G-banding ideogram
templates.use_when: Show supplied cytoband or chromosome-arm intervals as a karyotype ideogram.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for gene loci labels, continuous density windows, coverage tracks, or transcript exon models.

templates.title: Gene loci on chromosome ideograms
templates.use_when: Label supplied genomic loci on chromosome ideograms, optionally colored by category.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for transcript structure, unlabelled density windows, coverage browser tracks, or multi-track genomic Circos.

templates.title: Ideogram with continuous density fill
templates.use_when: Fill chromosome intervals with a supplied continuous window statistic such as density or population-genetic score.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for locus labels, coverage tracks, G-banding, transcript models, or dense site dandelion stems.

templates.title: Genomic locus coverage browser
templates.use_when: Stack supplied genomic signal tracks over a locus, with optional loop and gene sidecars.
templates.avoid_when: Do not run peak calling, loop calling, or fetch annotations. Do not use for whole-chromosome density or protein-domain mutation displays.

templates.title: Protein mutation lollipop
templates.use_when: Draw supplied protein residue positions and mutation classes on a protein axis, optionally using counts and domain sidecars.
templates.avoid_when: Do not parse MAF, fetch protein domains, use for genomic loci, or use for mutation-energy matrices.

templates.title: Dense-site dandelion plot
templates.use_when: Collapse dense supplied genomic or sequence sites into clustered dandelion stems with an optional feature sidecar.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for one-stem-per-site protein lollipops, whole-chromosome density windows, or locus coverage browsers.

templates.title: Multi-track genomic Circos
templates.use_when: Draw one genome as circular sectors with supplied quantitative tracks and optional supplied rearrangement links.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for weighted category chord diagrams, two-genome synteny ribbons, plain locus labels, or group-split non-genomic circular heatmaps.

templates.title: Genomic Circos heatmap with connectors
templates.use_when: Draw genomic intervals as circular heatmap tiles from supplied numeric layer columns, with connector lines to the loci.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for non-genomic group-split heatmaps, ordinary Circos tracks without heatmap tiles, or labelled loci without numeric layers.

templates.title: Nested Circos overview and zoom
templates.use_when: Show outer genomic windows and inner zoom coordinates with supplied sidecars for windows and scored points.
templates.avoid_when: Do not use for a single-layer Circos plot, genomic heatmap connectors, coverage browser tracks, or computed DMR discovery.

templates.title: Two-genome synteny Circos
templates.use_when: Compare two supplied assemblies with aligned interval blocks drawn as ribbons between genome sectors.
templates.avoid_when: Do not run alignment, BLAST, minimap, or MCScanX. Do not use for one-genome genomic Circos tracks or category chord diagrams.
